component.name: Pimpo
component.summary: A personal AI agent that learns a task once, then does it on its own

description.p: You ask in plain words. The first time, Pimpo does the task with a language model while you watch, rehearsing every change. When it works, Pimpo turns it into a routine: readable code with tests and a list of the only things it may touch, which then runs on schedule without a language model.
Every action passes your rules and lands in a tamper-evident log, and anything that cannot be undone waits for your approval. Your data stays on your computer.
